name: Headroom
hook: Context compression layer that cuts 20–95% of tokens before they reach any LLM — 21% off code searches, 57% off SRE debugging sessions, 42% off codebase exploration, and 60–95% on JSON payloads. Ships as library, proxy, agent wrapper, and MCP server. Created by a Netflix engineer to solve a personal $200/day problem. Apache 2.0, 73.7k stars, actively updated Sep 24.

name: OmniRoute
hook: Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1,200+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Quota-aware auto-fallback keeps agents coding when any provider hits its limit. Built-in RTK+Caveman compression saves 15–95% tokens. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline, and Copilot. 69.8k stars, updated Sep 24.

name: Superpowers
hook: Complete SDLC skills framework — 14 composable markdown files that enforce engineering discipline across the full cycle: brainstorm → worktree → plan → subagent execution → TDD → code review. Same folder works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. 280k+ stars and 25k+ forks. Philosophy: what AI coding agents are missing is not capability but discipline — and discipline distributes as plain text.

name: Matt Pocock Skills
hook: 38 agent skills straight from Matt Pocock's .agents directory — the Total TypeScript creator built these to fix four coding-agent failure modes: misalignment, verbosity, broken code, and poor architecture. Highlights: tdd, diagnosing-bugs, code-review, codebase-design, grill-with-docs, wayfinder. 269k stars. Install as a managed read-only bundle (updates auto) or editable copies you own.

name: wshobson/agents
hook: Multi-harness plugin marketplace: 94 plugins, 202 agents, 183 skills, 105 commands, and 16 orchestrators — all generated from one Markdown source and shipped as idiomatic artifacts for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi. MIT, 39.9k stars, 576 commits.

name: Awesome Agent Skills (VoltAgent)
hook: 1,000+ curated agent skills from official engineering teams — not AI-generated — covering Angular, Stripe, Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify, Firebase, Hugging Face, Replicate, Sentry, HashiCorp, and more. Updated Sep 23. 34.8k stars. Works across Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and VoltAgent's own framework.

name: notebooklm-py
hook: Full programmatic access to Google Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM) — including features the web UI doesn't expose. Source management, podcast/video/quiz/flashcard generation, grounded chat, and bulk exports, all via Python, CLI, MCP server, or agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. MIT, 19.5k stars, updated Sep 23.

name: video-digest (simonlee2)
hook: Claude Code skill (Sep 3, 2026) that turns any YouTube playlist, conference stream, or local video files into a shareable web digest — TL;DRs, key takeaways, and slides paired to narration. Part of simonlee2's 8-skill collection. Works on Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents via the skills CLI.

name: claude plugin eval (Week 37)
hook: New `claude plugin eval` command (shipped Week 37, v2.1.263–269) runs your plugin against a suite of test cases, scores results, and compares against a no-plugin baseline — `claude plugin eval init` auto-drafts the cases and graders. Closes the gap between publishing a skill and knowing whether it actually improves Claude's output.

name: /skill-doctor (Week 36)
hook: New `/skill-doctor` command (shipped Week 36, v2.1.251–261) shows what each of your installed skills costs in context tokens and how often it gets invoked — the first built-in observability tool for the Claude Code skills layer. Identifies dead weight, over-loaded skills, and which ones are actually earning their token budget.

name: Claude Academy — 26 Courses
hook: Anthropic's free learning platform (rebranded from Anthropic Academy) has expanded to 26 courses across 5 tracks — up from ~6 at launch. Highlights: Claude Code 101 (agentic loop, CLAUDE.md, MCP, hooks), Claude Code in Action (production workflows), and Building with Claude API. Every course is free with completion certificates. academy.claude.com.
recurring_note: ↑ Expanded to 26 courses — original Skilljar entry in submissions.json (Apr 24)

name: youtube-digest-skill
hook: Claude Code / Codex / Gemini skill that transforms any YouTube video into structured knowledge: TL;DR, key takeaways, timestamped claims, topic timeline, and notable quotes in a single slash command. Pairs well with simonlee2's video-digest for conference-stream digests vs. individual deep-dives.
